observations: Brand 'YAMAHA' and model 'PortaSound PSS-480' are printed on the top left of the casing in photo 0 and bottom left in photo 2.
Features a 'Multi-Menu' section with sliders for 'Digital Synthesizer', 'Custom Drummer', and 'Bass/Chord Voice'.
Two built-in speakers are visible on the left and right sides.
The keys appear to be in alignment with no obvious physical damage or missing parts.
The casing shows minor surface wear consistent with age.

A photo of the power adapter plugged in and the keyboard's power LED lit.

risks.proof: A photo of the open battery compartment on the underside.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powered on and playing sounds from every key.
Photo of the power adapter if included.
